_comment: 'Lightning Flow - If you've played a Lightning card this turn, this gets go again.' Word for word the Aggressive Pounce sentence with a different condition, so the same shape: WHILE_STATIC gated on SOURCE_IS_ATTACK (CR 6.2.3d, condition evaluated at all times; go again paid at the Resolution Step, CR 8.3.5b). It was an ACTIVATE with no cost, which is not a thing the player can ever do -- so the clause never ran AND the printed GoAgain applied unconditionally, making the Lightning Flow gate pure decoration. The flag name itself was fixed earlier: the engine records a played Lightning card as "played_lightning".
